SRC-091:R001.text: CORE-001: Verified provider identity becomes authoritative quota-pool projection across usage limit service, UI capacity presentation, and notification deduplication

SRC-091:R002.text: CORE-002: _load_silo_identities does not commit to disk before startup safety snapshot is published; repairs in memory and persists via save transaction

SRC-091:R003.text: W2-001: Ordinary window close remains resident action without calling QApplication.quit or retiring workers; quit_app remains single canonical quit entry

SRC-091:R004.text: W2-002: UsageLimitService.shutdown retains ownership of unfinished timed-out futures across repeat calls; repeat shutdown remains bounded; executor shutdown waits only when all futures terminal

SRC-091:R005.text: PERF-001: Sync binding metadata cardinality bounded; retire unused lease entries once unconfigured and unfenced; reset/sweep profile-scoped sync caches together on profile switch

SRC-091:R006.text: PERF-002: Audit and narrow settings-only mutations to mark_dirty('settings') so single-domain setting changes like sound_volume do not trigger full multi-domain DB scan
